module_info: parm=hciextn:Convert HCI Extensions into BCSP packets
parm=txcrc:Transmit CRC with every BCSP packet
parm=quirks:Add/modify USB HID quirks by specifying  quirks=vendorID:productID:quirks where vendorID, productID, and quirks are all in 0x-prefixed hex
parm=scsi_logging_level:a bit mask of logging levels
parm=inq_timeout:Timeout (in seconds) waiting for devices to answer INQUIRY. Default is 20. Some devices may need more; most need less.
parm=max_report_luns:REPORT LUNS maximum number of LUNS received (should be between 1 and 16384)
parm=max_luns:last scsi LUN (should be between 1 and 2^32-1)
parm=default_dev_flags:scsi default device flag integer value
parm=dev_flags:Given scsi_dev_flags=vendor:model:flags[,v:m:f] add black/white list entries for vendor and model with an integer value of flags to the scsi device info list
parm=use_both_schemes:try the other device initialization scheme if the first one fails
parm=old_scheme_first:start with the old device initialization scheme
parm=initial_descriptor_timeout:initial 64-byte descriptor request timeout in milliseconds (default 5000 - 5.0 seconds)
parm=blinkenlights:true to cycle leds on hubs
parm=authorized_default:Default USB device authorization: 0 is not authorized, 1 is authorized, -1 is authorized except for wireless USB (default, old behaviour
parm=usbfs_memory_mb:maximum MB allowed for usbfs buffers (0 = no limit)
parm=usbfs_snoop:true to log all usbfs traffic
parm=nofua:true to ignore SCSI WRITE(10,12) FUA bit
parm=cdrom:true to simulate CD-ROM instead of disk
parm=file:names of backing files or devices
parm=qmult:queue length multiplier at high/super speed
parm=nofua:true to ignore SCSI WRITE(10,12) FUA bit
parm=cdrom:true to simulate CD-ROM instead of disk
parm=file:names of backing files or devices
parm=n_ports:number of ports to create, default=1
parm=quirks:supplemental list of device IDs and their quirks
parm=delay_use:seconds to delay before using a new device
description=USB Mass Storage driver for Linux
description=Generic file read (fb in system RAM)
parm=l2cap_ertm:Use L2CAP ERTM mode for connection
parm=l2cap_mtu:Default MTU for the L2CAP connection
parm=channel_mtu:Default MTU for the RFCOMM channel
parm=ieee80211_default_rc_algo:Default rate control algorithm for mac80211 to use
parm=probe_wait_ms:Maximum time(ms) to wait for probe response before disconnecting (reason 4).
parm=beacon_loss_count:Number of beacon intervals before we decide beacon was lost.
parm=max_nullfunc_tries:Maximum nullfunc tx tries before disconnecting (reason 4).
